answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered production supervisor shift record with production managers standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 454 pays 8172 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the shale up to the light, weigh the echo of the attack, and keep the zephyr of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
